name: Contact Other Plane

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Put up to five questions to an otherworldly mind, at the risk of your sanity.
text: You make a DC 15 Intelligence save: on a failure you take 6d6 Psychic damage and are Incapacitated until a Long Rest (Greater Restoration ends it); on a success you may ask up to five questions, answered with a word or short phrase, possibly unhelpfully.
